name: Frances Barton
title: Communications specialist and media trainer
bio_short: Communications specialist with more than 25 years' experience in broadcast journalism and public relations. BBC-trained. Former Emirates Group, Dubai Airports and Dubai Tourism. Delivers media training and crisis communication in Dubai.
bio: Frances is a communications specialist with more than 25 years' experience in broadcast and print journalism and public relations. She began her career in-house at BBC Northern Ireland, later working as a news editor and presenter for the BBC and for Dubai Television and Radio. She has also served as editor-in-chief of a high-end lifestyle magazine and contributed to UK and UAE newspapers.  As a PR professional, Frances has worked extensively on media relations, employee engagement and crisis communications for major organisations including Emirates Airline and Group, Dubai Airports, F&E Aerospace (Dubai Airshow), the American University of Sharjah and Dubai Tourism. Her experience spans both media and corporate communications, giving her a dual perspective that is valuable in media training.  At ISOC, Frances delivers corporate communications, crisis communication, media training and writing programmes. Her combination of BBC broadcast training, editorial experience and senior in-house PR roles means she understands both how journalists work and how organisations should prepare for and manage media engagement. She is particularly effective at helping participants develop confidence in handling press enquiries, preparing for interviews and managing reputational issues. Frances is based in Dubai and trains in English.
